d:
Aditya Music presents the best romantic song "Undiporaadhey" from the film "Hushaaru," starring Abhinav Medishetti and Priya Vadlamani. This movie, directed by Sree Harsha Konuganti, features a hit track composed by Radhan. With mesmerizing vocals by the talented Sid Sriram, this song perfectly captures the essence of love.
Song: Undiporaadhey
Movie: Hushaaru (Celebration Of Bad Behaviour)
Banner: Lucky Media
Producers: Bekkem venugopal & Riaz
Co-Producer: Veena Rani
Associate Producers: Linga Srinivas, Laxmi Narayana
Director: Sree Harsha Konuganti
